title: Classify focused Node test intent when flags precede --test or an inner shell wraps tests
outcome: Focused-launcher feedback gives unsupported-test guidance for known test intent that falls outside the bounded grammar, including preceding Node flags and supported inner shell wrappers, without admitting more verification.
acceptance: Feedback identifies Node test intent when supported option forms precede --test and known test intent inside an inner shell, while script arguments or unrelated non-test commands remain classified as non-test.

Regressions cover node --import ./x.mjs --test f.test.mjs, node -r mod --test f.test.mjs, an inner pwsh wrapper around cargo test, and a non-test script control; recognition, envelope guards and credit remain unchanged.
